<js>
function decrypt(config, encryptedData) {
return java.fns.AES_Decrypt(encryptedData, {
key:config["dataPassword"],
iv:config["iv"]
}, true)
}



var chapterImages = result.match(/chapterImages = "([^"]*)"/)[1];
var chapterPath = result.match(/chapterPath = "([^"]*)"/)[1];
var config = {
iv:"opb4x7z21vg1f3gI",
bm: "UTF-8",
dataPassword:"cxNB23W8xzKJV26O"
}
var list = JSON.parse(decrypt(config, chapterImages));

var ch_list = [];
var host = "http://mangaimg.huliqun.com:44240/";
for (var i=0; i<list.length; i++) {
if (list[i].search(/^https?:\/\/(images.dmzj.com|imgsmall.dmzj.com)/i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = host+"showImage.php?url="+list[i];
}
else if (list[i].search(/^[a-z]\//i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = host+"showImage.php?url=https://images.dmzj.com/"+list[i];
}
else if (list[i].search(/^(http:|https:|ftp:|^)\/\//i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = list[i];
}
else {
ch_list[i] = host+chapterPath+list[i];
}
}
ch_list;
</js>

var pn = parseInt(chapter.end_num-chapter.start_num+1);
var piclist = new Array(pn);
for (var i = 0; i < pn; i++) {
  piclist[i] = host+(i+1)+ext+"-aym.high.webp";
}
piclist
</js>@Header:{Referer:host}

<js>
var chapters = JSON.parse(result).data.comic_chapter;
var chapter;
for (var i=0; i<chapters.length; i++) {
  if (String(chapters[i].chapter_id) == "@get:{chapter_id}") {
    chapter = chapters[i];
    break;
  }
}

var path = chapter.rule;
var host = "https://mhpic.manhualang.com" + path.split("$$")[0];
var ext = path.split("$$")[1];
var pn = parseInt(chapter.end_num-chapter.start_num+1);
var piclist = new Array(pn);
for (var i = 0; i < pn; i++) {
  piclist[i] = host+(i+1)+ext+"-aym.high.webp";
}
piclist
</js>@Header:{Referer:host}

<js>
var chapters = JSON.parse(result).comic_chapter;
var chapter;
for (var i=0; i<chapters.length; i++) {
  if (String(chapters[i].chapter_id) == "@get:{chapter_id}") {
    chapter = chapters[i];
    break;
  }
}

var path = chapter.rule;
var host = "https://mhpic.cnmanhua.com" + path.split("$$")[0];
var ext = path.split("$$")[1];
var pn = parseInt(chapter.end_num-chapter.start_num+1);
var piclist = new Array(pn);
for (var i = 0; i < pn; i++) {
  piclist[i] = host+(i+1)+ext+"-aym.high.webp";
}
piclist
</js>@Header:{Referer:host}

<js>
function decrypt(config, encryptedData) {
return java.fns.AES_Decrypt(encryptedData, {
key:config["dataPassword"],
iv:config["iv"]
}, true)
}



var chapterImages = result.match(/chapterImages = "([^"]*)"/)[1];
var chapterPath = result.match(/chapterPath = "([^"]*)"/)[1];
var config = {
iv:"opb4x7z21vg1f3gI",
bm: "UTF-8",
dataPassword:"cxNB23W8xzKJV26O"
}
var list = JSON.parse(decrypt(config, chapterImages));

var ch_list = [];
var host = "http://fanyi.flj.fyi/";
for (var i=0; i<list.length; i++) {
if (list[i].search(/^https?:\/\/(images.dmzj.com|imgsmall.dmzj.com)/i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = host+"showImage.php?url="+list[i];
}
else if (list[i].search(/^[a-z]\//i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = host+"showImage.php?url=https://images.dmzj.com/"+list[i];
}
else if (list[i].search(/^(http:|https:|ftp:|^)\/\//i)==0) {
ch_list[i] = list[i];
}
else {
ch_list[i] = host+chapterPath+list[i];
}
}
ch_list;
</js>

<js>
var chapters = JSON.parse(result).data.comic_chapter;
var chapter;
for (var i=0; i<chapters.length; i++) {
  if (String(chapters[i].chapter_id) == "@get:{chapter_id}") {
    chapter = chapters[i];
    break;
  }
}

var path = chapter.rule;
var host = "https://mhpic.cnmanhua.com" + path.split("$$")[0];
var ext = path.split("$$")[1];
var pn = parseInt(chapter.end_num-chapter.start_num+1);
var piclist = new Array(pn);
for (var i = 0; i < pn; i++) {
  piclist[i] = host+(i+1)+ext+"-kmh.high.webp";
}
piclist
</js>@Header:{Referer:host}

<js>
var chapters = JSON.parse(result).data.comic_chapter;
var chapter;
for (var i=0; i<chapters.length; i++) {
  if (String(chapters[i].chapter_id) == "@get:{chapter_id}") {
    chapter = chapters[i];
    break;
  }
